title: My Sister's Keeper
author: Jodi Picoult
summary: A thirteen-year-old girl, conceived to be a match for her sister who has leukaemia, hires a lawyer to sue her parents for control over her own body. The case divides the family.
readIf: you like emotional family dramas built around a moral dilemma with no easy side.
skipIf: you want to avoid stories about childhood cancer and the strain it places on a family.

pairings.reason: Another story of young people facing cancer, with more romance and wit.
Another tear-jerker that asks hard questions about choice, family and who has the right to decide.
A quieter, stranger novel about young people whose bodies belong to others.
